attributes.$control__question: Can I connect my Google calendar?
attributes.$control__answer: Yes. You can connect Google Calendar from settings screen under connect tab.

attributes.$control__question: How accurate is the AI summary?
attributes.$control__answer: We use the latest LLM technologies specifically. It analyze nuance and technical details with over 98% user satisfaction.

attributes.$control__question: Can I use AppDrop with my team?
attributes.$control__answer: Absolutely. Shared Workspaces in the Pro plan allow for team collaboration.
